answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fakes. A new agent locks a 200-credit bond losing 5% each epoch unless renewed by work, like a reef kept alive by flowing water. Audits drop duplicates to zero, opening a canyon gap between live and dead bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 credits plus renewal work each, while split rewards stay below upkeep, so attacks lose money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards toward the horizon.
